stances_toward.note: ASEAN neighbour and partner in everyday terms, with an old wound underneath: the Sabah claim that the Philippines has never formally dropped. It is dormant at state level (the USD 14.9bn arbitral award of 2022 won by private Sulu heirs against Malaysia is a private claim that Kuala Lumpur rejects; Anwar said in 2023 that he had no evidence of Philippine government involvement) but Kuala Lumpur still treats each new claim as a threat to sovereignty. Partner because neither state wants the claim to move; bond grievance because the claim is open. Confidence C: no 2025-26 government statement found.
